Gengar is a Colbur Cursed Body special attacker that leads or pivots in to chip Fighting-types with Psychic; do not let it get a free hit on an Intimidate user. Excadrill is sand-mode backup (Life Orb Sand Rush) and will Protect the turn it expects a switch-in. Hippowdon (Smooth Rock) and Gyarados (Wacan Berry) were benched both games — opponent is comfortable running Blaziken-Mega as a sunless answer rather than committing to sand. Houndoom (Charcoal Flash Fire Timid 161 Spe) is the confirmed series MVP: it survives Blaziken-Mega's Close Combat and outspeeds unboosted Blaziken, making it the natural bring whenever Blaziken-Mega is in. Future plan: if opponent leads Blaziken + non-Whimsicott, double-target Blaziken with Houndoom + a Fairy/Water resist; if Whimsicott is in, Fake Out or OHKO it before turn 3. Avoid stacking Sneasler and Tauros on the same squad against Blaziken-Mega — neither survives Brave Bird and both are dead weight without redirection. The intended Mega slot (if any) did not show on the final state and likely was not brought; reconsider whether a dedicated Mega (e.g., Houndoomite for extra power, or a redirection Mega like Slowbro) would have stabilized the Sneasler/Tauros/Sinistcha core.
